Sealing the bytes would add ~2.9 MB of data to every future anchor for no gain in proof.

verification.method: each file re-read from disk and hashed with hashlib.sha256 in this run; where the weights landing had already recorded a sha256, the two are compared and a mismatch aborts the tool
verification.why: a tokenizer file is data. Checking its bytes with a runtime would put donor runtime on the path C4 audits, which is the thing R11 and the instrument tests exist to keep off it.
